ideas.problemStatement: Manual sorting of 2000+ diploma examination papers consumes 15+ teacher hours each exam cycle.
ideas.proposedSolution: Optical barcode scanner and stepper-motor bin diverter powered by Raspberry Pi Pico.

blogs.title: How IEDC GPTC PMNA Built an Award-Winning Solar Rover
blogs.excerpt: A behind-the-scenes journey of how diploma electronics students transformed raw scrap parts and microcontrollers into a state-winning rover.
blogs.content: Building an autonomous solar rover inside a polytechnic makerspace was both challenging and exhilarating. Our team of second and third-year students spent evenings in the ICFC lab experimenting with motor drivers, LoRa radio packets, and computer vision models...
blogs.author: Prof. Muhammed Rashid
